result.frameworkVersion: Aperture 0.3.0 — current working tree stipulated by benchmark protocol
implementedObjects: Raised square diorama base and L-shaped asphalt street
Pale tiled sidewalk, segmented curb, lane dashes and zebra crossing
Cream three-storey corner cafe with two glazed storefronts and wrapped red/cream striped awnings
Sage-green two-storey bookshop with panelled door, books in display windows and BOOKS sign
Upper windows, cornices, quoins, flat parapet roofs, chimney, service boxes and roof vent
Blue and mustard compact cars with extruded cabins, windows, wheels, bumpers, grilles and lights
Two faceted trees in square planters
Two street lamps with emissive lantern panes
Wood bench, small cafe table, two chairs, potted plants and pavement menu board
knownGaps: Store interiors and upper-window plants are deliberately shallow and simplified; glazing is opaque.
Cars are more angular and toy-like than the reference.
Shop lettering uses small procedural block glyphs rather than the reference serif lettering.
Sidewalk corner remains square; the reference has a beveled corner and tactile paving.
Lighting is flatter and shadows more defined than the soft photographic reference.
qualitativeEffortNotes: Used public app/config and app/systems facade, ECS-authored geometry and generated worker/browser route. Demand cadence and common time-0 explicit frame capture.
No external meshes, textures, generated images, peer sources or prior benchmark code used.

First capture failed because custom spherical crowns contained duplicate polar vertices; the retained report exposed the exact zero-area triangle. Fixing author geometry resolved it. The failure incurred the full 120-second capture timeout.
The first successful image exposed sRGB hex values being passed as linear PBR colors; explicit conversion restored saturation and contrast.
A rotated car windshield needed public quatFromEulerYXZ because rotationEulerDegrees uses XYZ composition.
Final crowns use a deterministic subdivided icosahedron algorithm with three restrained leaf tones.

Six capture attempts total: one failed and five passed; every successful PNG inspected before revision. One static build passed; an earlier CLI invocation used unsupported --root and was corrected by building from the author directory.

implementedObjects: Cream three-storey corner cafe with cornices, dressed corner stones, two visible window facades, roof parapets, chimney and service box
Sage two-storey bookshop with three upper windows, shop glazing and modest book shelving
Red-and-cream striped cafe awnings and procedural serif CAFE / BOOKS signs
Square raised diorama, pale tiled sidewalk and curb, L-shaped asphalt road, dashed lane markings and zebra crossing
Blue and mustard compact cars with tapered cabins, dark windows, wheels, headlights and bumpers
Two faceted trees in raised square planters
Two street lanterns, slatted bench, bistro table and two chairs, potted plants, chalk pavement board
knownGaps: Shop interiors and window reflections are simplified geometric color layers.
Awning valances are straight rather than scalloped.
Materials use an authored diffuse shader with filtered directional shadows, without physically based reflection or screen-space ambient occlusion.
Car bodies and foliage are deliberately angular; the source image has softer detailing.
qualitativeEffortNotes: Completed within the 25-minute ceiling using five of six allowed capture attempts.

Two early captures failed on vGPU integration requirements: prepared ShaderSource v2 and matching named attributes in the shadow vertex entry. Both were corrected using installed package documentation.

Three verified captures were viewed. Visual revisions improved camera elevation/framing, foliage winding, wheel caps and cabin taper, lighting/PCF, shadow-frustum bounds, car placement and shop lettering.
No peer author files, peer evidence, previous benchmark implementation, stock meshes, image-generation tools or external scene assets were used.

qualitativeEffortNotes: Initial geometry and native WebGPU integration built directly with primitives and a small authored cabin mesh.
Five captured attempts including two failed GPU validations; three verified images inspected.
GTAO required a non-multisampled depth prepass; direct MSAA depth produced invalid textureGather WGSL.
Denoising required an explicit RTT pass before material sampling to avoid depth read/write conflict.
Two standalone Vite builds and five capture-managed builds.
No framework, shared harness, peer directory or prior benchmark implementation changes.
